name: runner_path_invariance
origin: INQ-CHARTER-0001 attempt 1 (lineage 60b4 attempt) failed with IndexError on `ROOT.parents[i] for i in range(1, 6)` when invoked from a shallow path inside warp zone.
contract: e3_runner.find_pack_root() MUST: (1) iterate parents lazily via `for cand in chain` (NEVER `parents[i]`); (2) cap walk depth at MAX_DEPTH=10; (3) include Path.cwd() as a fallback candidate; (4) raise RuntimeError with a descriptive message instead of IndexError when no marker is found; (5) treat presence of TASK_MANIFEST.json OR PROVENANCE.json OR (_HARNESS/ AND ORGANS/) as a pack-root marker.

invariants.check: running from a freshly created tmp dir 1 level deep yields RuntimeError, not IndexError
running from PACK_ROOT itself succeeds and returns PACK_ROOT
running from PACK_ROOT/_HARNESS/RUNNER/ succeeds and returns PACK_ROOT (3 parents up)
NO_TESTS condition still writes RESULTS.json and EXECUTION_LOG.txt and exits with code 2

test_strategy: Covered by test_inq_tools_e3.py::T0_runner_path_invariance which exercises INV-1..INV-5 via subprocess calls to e3_runner.py and direct in-process import.
